items.headline: Halcyon Interconnect tops Q3 estimates, lifts full-year outlook
items.body: Halcyon reported Q3 EPS of $1.79 against a $1.62 consensus and raised FY2026 revenue guidance to $5.75–5.85B.

items.headline: 1.6T transceivers pass half of Halcyon's optics shipments
